prompt:
You judge whether one job posting is relevant to a candidate profile.

Candidate profile (fictional):
{
 "target_titles": [
  "supply chain analyst",
  "supply chain strategy",
  "procurement analyst",
  "demand planner",
  "project manager",
  "product manager",
  "operations analyst"
 ],
 "skills": [
  "sql",
  "power bi",
  "sap",
  "mrp",
  "forecasting",
  "inventory",
  "excel",
  "procurement"
 ],
 "locations": [
  "boston",
  "cambridge",
  "somerville",
  "massachusetts"
 ],
 "exclude_keywords": [
  "director",
  "vp",
  "principal",
  "senior manager",
  "10+ years",
  "8+ years",
  "phd required"
 ]
}

Posting:
{
 "posting_id": "8311099",
 "title": "Strategy & Operations Analyst",
 "location": "Somerville, MA"
}

A posting is relevant if it is a supply chain, procurement, planning or ops analyst role, entry to mid level (5 years or less), in Boston or remote.

Reply with JSON only. No prose, no code fences. Exactly these keys:
{"posting_id": "<the posting_id above>", "verdict": "relevant" or "not_relevant", "resume_fields": [names from: target_titles, skills, locations, exclude_keywords], "posting_fields": [names from: title, content, location], "justification": "<one to three sentences naming the specific terms behind the verdict>"}
raw_response: {"posting_id": "8311099", "verdict": "relevant", "resume_fields": ["target_titles", "locations", "exclude_keywords"], "posting_fields": ["title", "location"], "justification": "The title \"Strategy & Operations Analyst\" matches the target titles \"operations analyst\" and \"supply chain strategy\", and \"Somerville, MA\" is a listed location in the Boston area. The title contains no excluded seniority terms such as director, principal or senior manager, so it reads as entry-to-mid level; no posting content was provided to confirm experience requirements."}
